qa_pair.question: Which saved direct agent can an external human request on example/widget, and which review scope does it use? Check the agent and repository grant. Answer command,scope using the API scope value.
For oss-review, which saved base skill stays attached when its end-to-end requirement is disabled, and what is that requirement's stable rule ID? Answer skill-name,rule-id.
Read code-review's configuration and the scope guide. What scope is saved, and does its independent full comparison publish to GitHub? Answer API-scope,yes-or-no.
Inspect ship-review and example/widget's permissions. How many instances would the group request, and is this group allowed on that repository? Answer count,yes-or-no.
Find example/widget's automatic review rule and resolve its target ID to a command name. Answer command,event using the saved event value.
Read oss-review's model and connection, then check the model compatibility guide. Answer model-id,connection-type,required-API-family.
Read oss-review's enabled required rule and the rule guide. If a completed worker omits that rule's check, which check status is added and is the review complete? Answer status,yes-or-no.
Read oss-review and the permissions guide. Can a GitHub commenter who is not a workspace member use this agent's open access to manage agents through the remote MCP? Answer yes or no.
Use workspace discovery and the agent schema to identify the current account's admin status and the default for newly created agents' trigger_access. Answer yes-or-no,default-value.

Read oss-review's scope and the rerun guide. If there is no compatible successful baseline, does it review the full diff, and does a repeated request while the same commit is active launch another worker? Answer yes-or-no,yes-or-no.
